scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplied, with an independent algebraic-form resolvent numerical checker and explicit comparison to broader prior flux formulas; no external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The iff threshold is specific to the -a versus 2a delta-sink geometry. It proves existence of at least two strict majority crossings, not exactly two; the scalar maximum C(B) is variational. The exact flux ratio is already implied by earlier broad two-defect resolvent work; priority risk remains for the sharp threshold.
title: Sharp reentrant capture-majority window for two partially absorbing Brownian targets
